- Handle edge cases: if list length < 3 return False; optionally sort the list to enable two-pointer technique and handle duplicates naturally.
- For each index i from 0 to n-3, fix l[i] and use two pointers (left=i+1, right=n-1) to find a pair such that l[i] + l[left] + l[right] == 0; move pointers based on sum (<0 increase left, >0 decrease right); ensure elements are distinct by index.
- If any triple found, return True; after loop ends return False.
